evidence: Six L4 gateways: gateway-security, gateway-engineering, gateway-ai, gateway-aesthetic, gateway-design, gateway-experience. Three-axis routing: Red axis (security/adversarial), Blue axis (engineering/build quality), Purple axis (aesthetic/design/UX). Gateways load on top of (not instead of) active L3 platform module. Gateway-security: cross-cutting security concerns not covered by L3. Activates on any target at L4 complexity or higher or with security/authentication/payments/PII/secrets tags. Phase A (Specify time): STRIDE analysis, security requirements as acceptance criteria. Phase B (pre-Executor): verdict PASS/FLAG/BLOCK. Red/Blue/Purple cycling: Phase A (Intel), B (Red), C (Blue), D (Purple). InferenceGuard activates when gateway-security is active. 37 framework files touched in gateway integration (2026-05-24).
